evidence_policy: Synthetic application QA cannot satisfy genuine PipeGen evidence requirements.

pipegen_evidence.required: Actual PipeGen requirement-stage output or exported requirement configuration
Actual Pipeline IR screenshot and exported configuration
Genuine selected model identifier, version, provenance and ONNX export details
Actual PipeGen compiler output and speed report from ONNX to TensorRT FP16
Actual live GPU DeepStream run on camera, video or supported stream
Real source metadata plus validated parser and actionable incident output
Dashboard incident and source status matched to genuine source metadata and actual pipeline run
